# Mutual Services Agreement

Draft ID: 22427e568e49c844
Template: msa-standard-2026-07
Effective date: 2026-07-15

## Parties

Provider: Northstar Ops LLC (Mira Chen)
Customer: Harbor Ledger Inc. (Jules Patel)

## Clauses

### Parties and Effective Date

Northstar Ops LLC and Harbor Ledger Inc. enter this agreement effective 2026-07-15.

### Services

Northstar Ops LLC will provide: Monthly operations analytics and invoice reconciliation support..

### Fees and Payment

Harbor Ledger Inc. will pay USD 9,500 per month under Net 45 payment terms.

### Limitation of Liability

Liability cap: USD 75,000 aggregate cap.

### Confidentiality

Confidentiality period: 3 years.

### Governing Law

Governing law: Delaware.

## Deviations from template baseline

- governing_law: baseline "New York" -> proposed "Delaware"
- liability_cap: baseline "Fees paid in the prior 12 months" -> proposed "USD 75,000 aggregate cap"
- payment_terms: baseline "Net 30" -> proposed "Net 45"
